description: Checkout summary where line items scroll while the total stays fixed.

import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { ScrollArea } from "@workspace/ui/components/scroll-area" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const items = [ { name: "Linen Shirt", qty: 2, price: 68, tone: "from-stone-200 to-stone-400", }, { name: "Canvas Tote", qty: 1, price: 32, tone: "from-amber-200 to-orange-400", }, { name: "Wool Beanie", qty: 1, price: 24, tone: "from-slate-300 to-slate-600", }, { name: "Trail Sneaker", qty: 1, price: 120, tone: "from-emerald-200 to-teal-500", }, { name: "Rain Shell", qty: 1, price: 145, tone: "from-sky-200 to-indigo-500", }, { name: "Merino Socks", qty: 3, price: 14, tone: "from-rose-200 to-pink-400", }, ] export default function CheckoutOrderSummary() { const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.qty * i.price, 0) return (
Order summary
{items.map((item) => (
{item.qty}
{item.name} ${item.qty * item.price}.00
))}
Subtotal ${subtotal}.00
Shipping Free
Total ${subtotal}.00
) }
